2. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
- Lead the Design Handshake: Review design tech packs to ensure all technical information is comprehensive, accurate, and clearly translated for vendors and the COE (Center of Excellence).
- Stakeholder Alignment: Establish seamless communication channels across Sourcing, Design, Brand Management, and internal leadership.
- Facilitate COE Operations: Act as the liaison between the COE and vendors, ensuring accurate delivery of critical assets (size specs, reference samples, patterns, and markers).
- Weekly T&A (Time & Action) Reviews: Conduct weekly alignment meetings with stakeholders to review the Buy Plan and accurately forecast sample volumes for the upcoming weeks and months.
3. Technical Design & Sample Management
- PLM & Spec Management: Develop accurate size specifications for every style, upload them to the PLM system, and ensure vendors fully comprehend the technical requirements.
- Lead Sample Reviews: Facilitate cross-functional sample review sessions (Proto and Pre-Production/Gold Seal) alongside the Design team.
- Strict SLA Adherence: Consolidate design and technical comments, communicating them to vendors and updating the PLM system within a strict 48-hour window.
4. Calendar & Timeline Management
- Action Calendar Execution: Manage the product development timeline, mapping Proto requirements and size specs against the line assortment strategy.
- Buy Plan Management: Drive the Pre-Production (PP) / Gold Seal approval process, ensuring timelines are managed and resolved within a 3-day SLA.
- Production Readiness: Ensure all PP samples are fully approved at least 45 days prior to the ex-factory delivery date.
- System Updates: Ensure timely management of size specs (style-level and seasonal master charts), style attributes, and routine system updates (e.g., Dexter/PLM).
5. Quality Assurance & KPI Reporting
- First-Time Right (FTR) Metric: Monitor Proto and PP rejection rates. Conduct thorough root-cause analyses to continuously improve the FTR hit rate.
- Master Data Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date sample tracker detailing brand/style IDs, sample types, and approval statuses. If rejected, clearly categorize the root cause:
- Design/Fit adjustments
- Spec/Pattern inaccuracies
- Workmanship/Out-of-tolerance issues
- Return Rate Optimization: Analyze customer return data to formulate and execute actionable plans that reduce fit and quality-related returns.
- Vendor Pattern Auditing: Collaborate with the COE to audit and validate the accuracy of vendor patterns.
- Weekly Reporting: Flash key metrics (Proto/PP counts, system updates, spec statuses) and report pending action items to the Line Manager/Team Lead.
6. Continuous Professional Development
- 360-Degree Feedback: Participate in a comprehensive stakeholder feedback loop every quarter (3 months). Work in agreement with the Team Lead to develop and execute targeted performance improvement plans based on these insights. Qualifications & Experience
